podcast.title: Collaboration with Father
podcast.body: Robert Been and his father, Michael Been, worked together extensively with Black Rebel Motorcycle Club, right up until Michael's death. Michael was serving as a soundman for the band at a festival in Brussels when he suffered a fatal heart attack on August 19th, 2010. "Dad and son worked together for quite a bit with Black Rebel Motorcycle Club right to the end. And I mean the real end. On August 19th of 2010, Dad was working as a soundman for his son's band, a festival in Brussels. When he had a fatal heart attack, he died right there."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Identity and Band Formation
podcast.body: Born on August 22nd, 1978, Robert Bean initially used the name Robert Turner in music to avoid association with his father, Michael Been. His career breakthrough came with the band Black Rebel Motorcycle Club, formed in 1998 and still active today. He later reverted to using his birth name, Robert Bean. "On August 22nd 1978, he had a son named Robert Bean. When he got into music, he called himself Robert Turner, just so people wouldn't associate him with his father. His break came with a band called Black Rebel Motorcycle Club, a great group formed in 1998 and one that continues today. He's since reverted to calling himself Robert Bean."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Formation and Continuity
xref.body: Black Rebel Motorcycle Club was formed in 1998 by Robert Been and continues to be an active group today. Robert Been initially used the name Robert Turner to distance himself from his father's musical legacy, Michael Been of The Call. "His break came with a band called Black Rebel Motorcycle Club, a great group formed in 1998 and one that continues today."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Pride in Son's Work
xref.body: Michael Been was very proud of his son Robert Been's accomplishments with his group, Black Rebel Motorcycle Club. "And Michael Bean was really, really proud of what his son has done with his group."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Reunions with Robert Been
xref.body: Following Michael Been's death, there have been Call reunions where his son, Robert Been, filled in for his father. "Since then, there have been some call reunions during which Robert filled in for Dad."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
